title: SF AI Summit 2026 travel + expenses scratchpad
content:
Quick run-down / scratchpad for SF AI Summit 2026 (internal notes)

Conference basics:
- Dates: March 16-18, 2026 (expo + talks). Travel nights: arrive 3/15, depart 3/19 (red-eye?)
- Venue: Moscone Center South, San Francisco
- Booth: Island B12 (confirm exact map with events team)

Travel bookings:
- Flight: booked on corporate card (Delta DL1234) 3/15 10:50am SJC->SFO (hold luggage allowed) — PNR: H7K9LP
- Return: booked 3/19 6:30am SFO->SJC (early morning)
- Hotel: Parc 55 (block under Redwood Inference) — check-in 3/15, check-out 3/19; reservation name Alex Martinez; confirmation #P55-98234
- Ground: estimate rideshare costs ~ $60 total (to/from hotel + airport shuttles); try to use rideshare receipts for reimbursement

Booth & materials logistics:
- Booth crates arriving to Moscone on 3/14 via ShipCo. Tracking: SC-394857. Contact: Priya Kumar (ShipCo) +1-415-555-0123, priya@shipco.example.com
- AV vendor: SparkAV — contact Luis Ortega +1-650-555-9876 / luis@sparkav.example.com. Confirm mic, monitor, ethernet, power strip. Ask for arrival/setup time (recommended 3/14 after 10am).
- Marketing collateral: leave 30 demo usb drives, 200 one-pagers, 50 swag T-shirts (M/L). Swag pick-up at HQ on 3/13 — confirm with Ops (Jordan).

Expense capture reminders (for reimbursement):
- Must upload itemized receipts to Expensify within 30 days. Company policy: meals under $75 need to be itemized; anything above requires explanation.
- Categories to use: travel:air, travel:hotel, travel:meals, travel:ground, events:booth, events:shipping, events:vendor-services
- Per diem: not automatic — meals reimbursed on receipts. Keep note of shared meals with partners (list names on receipt).
- Tips/gratuity: include on receipt when possible; otherwise document in notes with approximate amounts.

Pending / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm final booth map and exact booth number with events team (Jordan) — blocked until EMC updates floorplan
- [ ] Confirm ShipCo arrival window and who will be onsite to receive crates (Ops contact: Jordan Kim)
- [ ] Finalize AV order with Luis (SparkAV): stage monitor + wireless lapel mic + HDMI cable (backup). Deadline 3/01.
- [ ] Double-check corporate card limit for hotel incidentals; if above limit, pre-approve personal card then expense. Ops asked to avoid personal card but may be needed.
- [ ] Build quick demo script and allocate 15 & 30 minute time slots for partner meetings. Jamie to own scheduling sheet.

Vendor contacts (quick):
- ShipCo (shipping + booth logistics): Priya Kumar, +1-415-555-0123, priya@shipco.example.com
- SparkAV (AV + install): Luis Ortega, +1-650-555-9876, luis@sparkav.example.com
- Hotel (Parc 55 events desk): Events Desk +1-415-555-4455, events@parc55.example.com — ask about storage for extra boxes and late check-out options
- Catering lead (on-site partner dinners): Olivia Chen, +1-415-555-3321, olivia@caterco.example.com

Reimbursement notes / tips:
- Photograph every receipt immediately and upload to Expensify; add short note: event name + date + category
- For shared expenses (dinners with partners), include attendee names in the expense notes to avoid delays
- If card charge is pending/unclear, keep the receipt and include merchant name + card last 4 in expense note

Meeting & partner notes:
- Pre-conference partner meetup with Vertex Labs (Tuesday 3/16 5:30pm near Moscone). Confirm signup and invite list.
- Quick sync with Solutions Eng (Samantha) on demo failures to avoid last minute surprises (check large model demo token limits)

Expenses rough estimates (for budget planning):
- Air (round trip): $180
- Hotel (3 nights): $720 (govt rate / conference rate applied)
- Ground: $60
- Meals: $200 (3 days + partner dinners)
- Booth shipping + install: $1,200
- AV: $600
- Swag/printing: $1,000
- Total estimate: ~$3,960 (ballpark)

Notes to self / messy thoughts:
- Bring extra HDMI adapter (USB-C -> HDMI) and USB-A -> USB-C dongle
- Demo laptop image: final build 3/10 then freeze; notify IT to push updates by 3/12
- Badge pickup: on-site 3/15 morning at exhibitor check-in desk — bring company ID and confirmation email. Save badge pickup location/map in calendar invite.
- Slack channel for the event: #events-sf-ai-2026 (watch for Ops pings)
- Emergency contact: Jordan Kim +1-650-555-0100

Questions unresolved:
- Can we expense booth photographer? (if yes, category events:services) — ask finance
- Are there any embargoed partner announcements during the show? Check comms with PR

End of scratchpad. Update this doc with receipts and final confirmations as stuff arrives.
